strengths: Read-only boundary is explicit and lists forbidden operations (failover, scale, restore).
Failure-domain, RTO/RPO and dependency coverage are concrete.

findings.issue: Provider-specific checks from the Azure source are reduced to a generic list; the per-resource assessment table (zone redundancy per plan, health-check path, storage LRS/ZRS) is gone.
findings.recommendation: Add a provider-variant checklist section (Azure first) with the per-resource table columns from the source.

findings.issue: Findings are 'prioritized' without a declared severity or effort scheme; source classifies quick wins (no downtime) versus migrations with cost impact.
findings.recommendation: Require each finding to carry severity, downtime impact and cost-impact fields.

lost_source_techniques: quick-win vs migration classification with cost and downtime flags

strengths: Measurement discipline (frozen journey, warmup, sample count, distribution) is strong.
Clean split from web-performance-diagnostics via mutual anti-triggers.

findings.issue: No quantitative budgets: no long-task (50 ms), frame (16.7 ms) or INP (200 ms) thresholds, so 'bottleneck' has no objective cut-off.
findings.recommendation: Add default budgets used when the user supplies none, and require reporting against them.

findings.issue: Known cause catalog from sources is absent: animating non-transform/opacity properties, parent CSS-variable driven child transforms, main-thread Framer Motion shorthands.
findings.recommendation: Add a hypothesis catalog mapping trace symptoms to these causes.

lost_source_techniques: avoid parent CSS variable driving child transforms
Framer Motion shorthand is not hardware-accelerated

strengths: Dry-run is allowed only when guaranteed non-mutating; otherwise marked unavailable.

findings.issue: Output is a free-form 'ready or blocked' list; the source's severity taxonomy (incompatible / requiresChanges / autoFixed) and per-issue Current/Required/Fix/Docs format are dropped.
findings.recommendation: Adopt the severity taxonomy, blocker-first ordering and per-issue record format.

findings.issue: AKS Automatic constraint-spec checks are not exposed as a provider variant.
findings.recommendation: Add an AKS Automatic variant referencing safeguard constraints such as container resource requests.

lost_source_techniques: group by constraint when more than 10 issues

strengths: One-factor-at-a-time variation and retry-masking detection are well specified.

findings.issue: Required input demands 'a confirmed cause' while the responsibility is to diagnose; the Skill cannot start on an unexplained flaky test, which is its main use case.
findings.recommendation: Change input to 'an observed nondeterministic or resilience failure with reproduction context'.

findings.issue: Condition-based waiting, the source's proven fix pattern for timing flakiness (15 flaky tests fixed), is not named as a hypothesis or recommendation.
findings.recommendation: List 'arbitrary sleep/timeout' as a first-class hypothesis and recommend condition-based waiting.

findings.issue: Defense-in-depth validation layers are cited as evidence but not used in recommendations.
findings.recommendation: Reference the four validation layers when recommending repairs for invalid-data causes.

strengths: Rejects single Lighthouse score as evidence.
Third-party boundary is part of the frozen setup.

findings.issue: Core Web Vitals are named without thresholds (LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1 at p75) and without lab-vs-field distinction.
findings.recommendation: Add good/needs-improvement/poor thresholds and require labelling lab versus field data.

findings.issue: Framework/bundler detection and tree-shaking checks that drive attribution are dropped.
findings.recommendation: Add bundler detection and bundle-attribution step to ownership analysis.

cross_skill_findings.issue: Both measure INP-adjacent interaction latency; ownership of INP is not stated.
cross_skill_findings.recommendation: Assign field INP to web-performance-diagnostics and component-level interaction traces to frontend-rendering-and-interaction-performance.
